operations.purpose: Read a finite window of an explicitly repeated identity cycle without creating or contacting tasks.
Compare equal-workload model mixes using explicitly supplied relative costs; do not infer billing or measured token consumption.
Compute a nonpreemptive first-come first-served timeline with explicit arrival times and service durations.
Calculate earliest-deadline ordering and lateness for jobs all available at time zero; retain missed deadlines.
Pack indivisible file or token costs with first-fit decreasing and label the result as a heuristic.
Calculate earliest finishes on an explicit acyclic dependency graph without treating missing dependencies as complete.
Separate cached and uncached input counts and compute a supplied rate scenario with complete type checks.
Split ordered indivisible modules while charging the stable prefix to every batch and refusing oversize modules.
Compute covered duration and missing intervals inside one observation window; duration is not measurement quality.
Allocate an integer workload with largest remainders, expose tie policy, and avoid equating numerical share with rights.
Update an explicitly synthetic Beta prior with binary outcomes and retain the prior and finite sample count.
Compute a fixed-alternative Bernoulli likelihood-ratio path; validity depends on the declared conditional null.
Form a finite joint probability law from an explicit prior and channel; symbols are not physical or conscious states.
Calculate Bayes risk for supplied finite losses, retaining ties and without choosing losses for affected people.
Reduce local attempt records with digest binding and absorbing acceptance; the reducer never submits a message.
Join declared subject, purpose, expiry and revocation records while retaining the distinction from real consent.
Expose missing or conflicted reviewers for synthetic decisions instead of converting a roster into legitimate review.
Compute bounded attempts and delay exposure under a stated failure probability; never retry accepted or opaque sends.
Select explicit typed path segments without evaluation, wildcard expansion, input mutation, or null-to-missing coercion.
Compare paired resource observations only when the workload and result digests agree; otherwise report a comparison gap.
